prerequisites.title: Own Xero OAuth app
prerequisites.detail: Composio has no managed Xero app, so you need your own client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: Security standards readiness
prerequisites.detail: Requirements include authentication, certification, personnel security, encryption and audit logging. Two-step authentication is the minimum, already met via Sign in with Xero.

prerequisites.title: Credit card for paid plan
prerequisites.detail: Starter needs no payment method; moving to Core needs a registered card.

steps.title: Register Xero app, get credentials
steps.detail: Log in to the Xero developer portal, create the OAuth app and note the client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your credentials. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into the Xero app: no wildcards, up to 50 URIs.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and the redirect URI is saved in Xero.

steps.title: Test with a permitted user
steps.detail: Connect a Xero organisation using a user with Standard, Adviser or Administrator level and the Connected Apps permission.
steps.done_when: A connected account works end to end.

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Prepare answers covering authentication, encryption, personnel security and audit logging from your docs.
steps.done_when: Draft answers are ready for review.

steps.title: Review and submit assessment
steps.detail: Verify the answers are accurate, then submit to Xero. Expect about 5 working days of effort.

steps.title: Wait for Xero security review
steps.detail: Xero reviews in about 5-10 working days and emails whether you passed.
steps.done_when: You receive the pass or fail email.

steps.title: Remediate failed items
steps.detail: If you do not pass, submit a remediation plan within 30 days and implement the changes within 60 days. Xero then re-reviews.
steps.done_when: Xero's re-review confirms the standards are met.

steps.title: Check certification button labels
steps.detail: Reportedly Xero checks the Sign Up and Sign In buttons are present and correctly labelled. Wrong labels commonly delay certification.

traps.title: Client cap before approval
traps.detail: A developer reported an unapproved app is limited to 25 connected clients, raised to 100 on initial approval. Plan the assessment before your pilot grows.

traps.title: Refresh tokens expire after 60 days
traps.detail: Unused refresh tokens expire after 60 days, so users must reauthorise. Keep tokens in use for idle customers.

traps.title: Annual repeat of the assessment
traps.detail: The security assessment must be done every year, so budget recurring effort.

traps.title: Fees are per app
traps.detail: Connections and data use are priced per app, so apps from the same developer cannot share allotments. Extra data costs extra.

traps.title: Granular scopes change
traps.detail: Apps created on or after 2 March 2026 get granular scopes automatically, such as accounting.invoices instead of accounting.transactions.

traps.title: Organisation missing from dropdown
traps.detail: An organisation will not appear if the user lacks Standard or Adviser permission there or the app is already connected.

blockers.symptom: Assessment not passed, remediation report received
blockers.what_it_means: Items did not meet the requirements.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days and implement the changes within 60 days.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan and track the fixes.

blockers.symptom: Cannot be certified or listed in the marketplace
blockers.what_it_means: Partners are not certified or listed without passing the assessments.
blockers.what_to_do: Complete and pass the security assessment.

evidence.quote: They’ll up the cap to 100 users, then above a 100 is more thorough in their questioning and review, beyond 1000 is a much more thorough process.
evidence.answer: A developer reported Xero raises the client cap to 100 on initial approval, with reviews more thorough above 100 and much more thorough above 1,000 users.

evidence.question: R1
evidence.quote: You'll need to pass all nine — plus have ten customers using your app — before Xero will certify it.
evidence.answer: A vendor that listed on the Xero App Store reports certification requires passing nine checkpoints and having ten customers using the app.

evidence.question: R1
evidence.quote: Xero will check that both buttons are present and correctly labelled — using the wrong label on either is a common reason for certification delays.
evidence.answer: A vendor reports that wrong Sign Up / Sign In button labels are a common cause of Xero certification delays.
